scheme_name: Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board.
Workers claiming organized sector employment but unable to prove it are eligible.
Construction workers not eligible for registration with the Chhattisgarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board are eligible.
A competent doctor must confirm Silicosis disease for the worker.
Application can be submitted by mother, father, spouse, or minor child of the worker.
benefits_summary: Unorganized workers with silicosis receive a financial assistance of ₹300,000; if the worker dies, the family receives ₹100,000 and the remainder is paid as a fixed deposit with monthly interest.
documents_required: Medical report confirming that the deceased worker had silicosis
